Send Δ 703.362.3221 sue@thegoodhartgroup.com allison@thegoodhartgroup.com Sell Your Home With ^ The Top Real Estate Agents in Alexandria and The DC Metro Area Group We’ve been selling homes in the DC Metro area, including Northern Virginia, Washington DC, Maryland, as well as Alexandria for over 30 years If there’s one thing we’ve learned, it’s that there’s always a lot to learn. Whether you’re moving from your starter home to upsize, or selling your long time family home to downsize, we’re with you every step of the way. We Do Things Differently We make this process as easy as possible, so you can smoothly transition into life’s next stage. Our dedicated team members and unique marketing has allowed us to sell over 3,000+ homes through our local expertise in the DC Metro area, including Northern Virginia, Washington DC, Maryland, as well as Alexandria. Proven Home-Selling ^ Tips & Strategy Selling real estate in Alexandria, VA, DC, and MD requires an experienced helping hand to sell quickly and successfully. Here’s how the process works and how we help: Book A Home Valuation 01 Meet, Review, Strategize It starts with a meeting. We’ll discuss your current situation, selling motivation, timeframe, and property information. We’ll go over the entire home selling process with you and walk you through our unique real estate marketing strategies so there’ll be no surprises along the way. Our approach means that we include our clients in every single detail throughout the home selling process. Together, we’ll discuss custom home selling tips, talk about your goals, and set a timeline that puts the best plan in motion. Selling New Construction 01 Preparing Your Home & Innovative Marketing Once your house is looking its best, we execute innovative marketing proven to get the job done. We envision the ideal buyer that would best suit the home, and target our marketing specifically to them, wherever they are. You’ll meet with our professional stager for a complimentary consultation. They’ll determine a list of staging recommendations based on your home and budget; depending on your needs, this can range from cleaning and decluttering to repainting and bringing in new furniture. If renovations or repairs are needed, that’s where Compass Concierge comes in. Our targeted marketing plans focus on the specific buyer profile we put together for each property. By advertising to the right demographic, we’ll find more interested buyers in less time. Our strategy is a combination of traditional and new media to showcase your home; using direct mail and paper advertising, as well as social media and email marketing, digital ads, and a prominent feature on our highly-trafficked website. Your listing will be published in local publications and magazines that showcase high-end listings, and the community newsletter that reaches approximately 12,000 people in the Alexandria area. Sold Listing Portfolio 03 Negotiating, Closing, Moving We know the neighborhoods, and we know Alexandria, Arlington, Fairfax County, Washington DC, and Montgomery County real estate. So when we get to the closing table, our team of expert negotiators will always get you a fair and justified price. Once we’ve closed the deal, we’ll help you move into your new home by finding movers that fit your schedule and budget. Expansive Networking We’ve built relationships with other top realtors throughout Alexandria and the DC Metro Area to create an extensive network of industry professionals. When listing your home, we reach out to these agents to match your home with the ideal buyer. You also benefit from our Compass network as well as our Realm network, where we connect with the best brokers throughout the country—and across the globe—who often highlight our sellers’ listings in their newsletters, social media campaigns, and other publications, reaching buyers worldwide. Consistent Dedication Selling your home is about more than just listing and hoping. It requires constant communication and honesty. We continually provide you with feedback from potential buyers and agents, and give you weekly updates on the state of the market and an action plan to sell your home. Seller Guide Tested Expertise From top listing agents to trusted professionals in the community, The Goodhart Group is available seven days a week. Featuring decades of industry experience and community insight, you’ll always receive solid advice you can trust. We are true listing agents who take our job seriously. We understand your home is your most precious asset, and that’s why we create custom plans for your unique listing. Whether your priority is a quick sale as-is or upgrading your home to get the highest price, we’ll help you do it with dedication and expertise you won’t find elsewhere—and that’s why we sell more homes than other teams in our marketplace. We couldn't have been in better hands. We highly recommend the entire Goodhart team to anyone seeking a top-notch real estate experience." Our 3-Phase Listing Approach 01 Private Exclusive Listing Thanks to our industry relationships, we’re able to sell your home without listing it in any database. This is a great way to expose your property to qualified potential buyers if you prefer a private, off-market sale. 02 Compass Coming Soon Through Compass Coming Soon we can pre-market your home to thousands of potential buyers both in the DC area and across the country to other Compass agents. That way, when it comes onto the market, we already have a list of interested buyers to tour your home. The results of using the Compass Coming Soon strategy have been incredible. Since it allows us to confidentially price your property and build early excitement, we have found that it’s the fastest way to secure the best possible offer. 03 On The Market When your home is ready for public listing day, we execute a comprehensive marketing plan that showcases your home to as many buyers as possible. We implement traditional print and innovative digital marketing strategies that maximize listing exposure, increase open house visits, and encourage top offers. Awards & Recognition Top Agent, Washingtonian 2025 RealTrends and Thousand ranked #2 State Volume Medium Team 2024 #1 Compass Team in Virginia in 2022 You Get More With Compass Compass Concierge Maximize the value of your home with Compass Concierge, the hassle-free way to increase the value of your property. If you want to take advantage of this offer, here’s what you can expect: From painting to ﬂooring and everything in between, Compass Concierge helps you easily prepare your home for the market by advancing the funds (up to five percent of the list price or 25,000) for home improvement services. We’ll work together to determine which services can increase your home’s value the most and set an estimated budget for the work. We’ll be by your side throughout the Concierge process so that you can make the most out of your sale. We’ll work with you to select the best vendors for the job, and you’ll contract directly with vendors without paying out-of-pocket costs. Once your home sells, simply pay back the funds that the program provided at a low percentage note—and nothing more. Compass Make Me Sell Not sure if you want to sell? Curious about your property value? As a Goodhart Group client, you become a Compass insider, which means we can privately test your listing within our database—without listing your home on the open market, or signing a lease agreement. This innovative program lets you comfortably consider selling, without the pressure of committing if you’re not ready. Click the button below to learn more, and sign up!
